findings.title: Verified account remains freely editable and still presents Sign in
findings.triggerStateSequence: authenticated=true, checked=true, connectorReady=true; the card re-renders after successful credential/tunnel/API-key checks; the user views or activates the card actions
findings.expected: Completed steps are read-only; only explicit Replace credentials or the permitted upgrade flow unlocks them; the primary action reflects the completed state.
findings.actual: Sign in, Check, and Check connector remain available outside manual mode, with no verified lock, replace action, or unlock transition.
findings.accessibilityImpact: Keyboard and screen-reader users receive actionable controls that imply incomplete setup after success, and the success dots do not explain which actions are locked or allowed.
findings.smallestFix: Derive a verified/locked view from the snapshot, disable or replace post-success actions, and add one explicit Replace credentials/upgrade transition with state-specific accessible labels.

findings.title: Unverified account can become current
findings.triggerStateSequence: authenticated=false or checked=false or connectorReady=false; the user activates Select on a non-current account
findings.expected: Selection is gated on the required verified state, or the action becomes Continue setup without marking the account current.
findings.actual: Select is disabled only for the current account or while busy; it does not consult authentication or verification flags before calling selectAccount.
findings.accessibilityImpact: The current badge can move to an incomplete account and present a misleading state relationship to assistive technology and keyboard users.
findings.smallestFix: Gate Select on the mode-specific minimum verified state or relabel it as Continue setup, with a status explanation associated with the control.

notes: Manual code review only; no tests, typecheck, scripts, runtime, app, commit, push, or delegation.
The actual account state machine needs an explicit completed/locked state and an explicit replace or upgrade transition before the UI can match the described screenshots.
